summary: Feature request to allow PayloadVisitor to run payload visitations concurrently for I/O-bound tasks with configurable concurrency level, defaulting to 1 for backward compatibility.
userImpact: Enables faster payload visitation for I/O-bound tasks by allowing concurrent processing instead of sequential execution.
proposedFix: Add an option to PayloadVisitor to control the maximum number of concurrent visitations, with default value of 1 to maintain backward compatibility.
resolutionDetails: Closed as duplicate of a features repo issue to consolidate cross-SDK work.
keyQuote: Add option to PayloadVisitor that allows more than one concurrent visitation to occur at a time. Then default value should be 1 to maintain backward compatible behavior
